about: Ledger entries for sentences the 2026-11-13 pages fix added to the case studies (branch fix/pages). Same format and checks as docs/case-study-facts*.json; kept here because docs/ belonged to the docs task during that fix. Fold these into docs/case-study-facts.json when the branches merge.

facts.sentence: The two KSU records share one goal but cover different work: the Spring 2022 poster is titled for an invasive BCI and sets out the aim, while the Fall 2022 talk is titled for a non-invasive BCI and adds the EEG recordings and the autoencoder and t-SNE method shown on this page.
quote: Brain-to-text communication through an invasive BC
this study seeks to have a more general model that can type any word in the vast English vocabulary
Brain-to-text communication through a non-invasive BCI
The collected data from the EEG signals is challenging to process
start by using an autoencoder to compress the data into a low-dimensional space, then use t-SNE
facts.note: Answers the t3 audit (finding 10): the page says non-invasive EEG while poster 255 is titled for an invasive BCI. Both abstracts state the same goal; only the Fall 2022 talk (136) describes EEG data and the autoencoder and t-SNE method.

facts.sentence: The report also notes that storing chat history as context for the model was withheld from the final product.
quote: store user chat information for a short period of time to provide the LLM with contextual information
this portion of the project was withheld from the final functioning product
facts.note: t3 audit finding 11: the page lists past conversations in the app; the report says keeping chat history for the model's context did not ship.

facts.sentence: The module sits in the LLM pipeline on the Python server: it reads textual cues in each message to name the emotion, and the model adjusts its reply to fit; the public report does not name the classifier behind it.
quote: a sentiment module added to the LLM pipeline that names the emotion in a message
designed to identify user emotions based on textual cues
integrated with the LLM so that the chatbot could now determine the emotion
adjust its responses to offer consolation or acknowledge accomplishments appropriately
facts.note: t3 audit finding 11: how the sentiment module works, from docs/case-study-answers.md and the report. Neither names the classifier, so the page says so.
